intro.title: Implement ValueOf type
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a custom TypeScript utility type called `ValueOf`. This type will extract the union of all possible property values from a given object type. The core concept involves using TypeScript's indexed access types to map over object keys and retrieve their corresponding value types. You will work with TypeScript's type system, focusing on generics and keyof operators. By the end, you'll understand how to create reusable type utilities that enhance type safety in your projects.
intro.usecase: The ValueOf type is essential when working with configuration objects, API responses, or UI state management in real applications. For example, in a dashboard application, you might have a theme configuration object with specific color values, and ValueOf helps extract those color strings for consistent styling. When building forms with validation rules, ValueOf can extract allowed input types from a validation schema. In e-commerce filters, it can extract permissible price ranges or category IDs from filter configuration objects, ensuring type safety throughout the filtering logic.
